verses.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪੁ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਨੈ ਜਾ ਮੈ ਬੀਤੇ ਮਦਨ ਮਦੋਨ ਮਤਿਵਾਰੋ ਜਗ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: prem ras ko prataap soiee jaanai jaa mai beete madhan madhon mativaaro jag jaaneeaai ||

en.bdb: He alone can appreciate the greatness of Lord's love-elixir who experiences it. It is just like a drunkard who is considered crazy by the world.

verses.gurmukhi: ਘੂਰਮ ਹੁਇ ਘਾਇਲ ਸੋ ਘੂਮਤ ਅਰੁਨ ਦ੍ਰਿਗ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਤੁ੍ਰਤਾ ਨਿਲਜ ਲਜਾ ਹੂ ਲਜਾਨੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: ghooram hui ghail so ghoomat arun dhirag mitr saturataa nilaj lajaa hoo lajaaneeaai ||

en.bdb: Just as a warrior wounded in the battlefield wanders around with his eyes blazing red, he shams the feeling of friendship and animosity,

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਰਸੀਲੀ ਕਥਾ ਅਕਥ ਕੈ ਮੋਨ ਬ੍ਰਤ ਅਨ ਰਸ ਰਹਿਤ ਉਤਰ ਬਖਾਨੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: rasanaa raseelee kathaa akath kai mon brat an ras rahit utar bakhaaneeaai ||

en.bdb: One enamoured by the love of God has his speech nectar-like due to perpetual recitation of Lord's indescribable traits. He adopts silence and is free from all other desires. He talks to no one and remains relishing the sweetness of Lord's naam.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੰਕੋਚ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਅਸਤੁਤਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਪਗ ਡਗਮਗ ਜਤ ਕਤ ਬਿਸਮਾਨੀਐ ॥੧੭੩॥
verses.translit_en: surat sa(n)koch samasar asatut ni(n)dhaa pag ddagamag jat kat bisamaaneeaai ||173||

en.bdb: He keeps all his desires under wrap. Praise and insult is all alike to him. In the stupor of Naam he is seen living a life of wonders and marvels. (173)
